subject.title: Telegram forum: no reliable topic-name -> topic_id resolution for agent routing

question: Should OpenClaw expose a Telegram forum topic title-to-topic_id routing surface, and should it be prompt context, a message action, or a channel metadata/plugin SDK endpoint?
rationale: Current code intentionally exposes names only after a numeric topic id is known; choosing forward routing needs maintainer intent for ambiguity, freshness, Bot API limits, and the agent/plugin contract.

options.title: Expose Observed Topic Catalog
options.body: Add a Telegram-owned list/catalog action or metadata endpoint returning known topic ids, names, closed state, and freshness so agents can ask when ambiguous.

options.title: Add Resolver-Only Helper
options.body: Add a direct name-to-id helper that returns structured ambiguity or stale-data errors instead of silently choosing among duplicates.

options.title: Keep Numeric-Only Routing
options.body: Leave topic names as display/context metadata and document numeric topic ids or chatId:topic:<threadId> as the only supported routing contract.

recommendation.title: Expose Observed Topic Catalog
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram-owned list/catalog action or metadata endpoint returning known topic ids, names, closed state, and freshness so agents can ask when ambiguous.

likelyOwner.reason: The likely design owner is tied to the persisted topic-name cache that any catalog or resolver would build on.
